_comment: TLS on the tailnet name, proxied to the relay's loopback listener inside
the shared network namespace. Only /relay and /healthz exist there; the
private observability listener on 9090 is deliberately not served, so
/readyz and /metrics stay off even the tailnet.
AllowFunnel is absent and must stay absent: Funnel would put this relay on
the public internet, which is the one thing this deployment path exists to
